description: Majik's Music Studio provenance / AI-disclosure manifest (L13). A machine-readable view over the hash-chained command journal plus asset content hashes: the generated/imported/recorded/authored split, per-clip lineage, engine identities, the blake3 hash-chain head, and the EU AI Act Article 50(2) disclosure fields with IPTC DigitalSourceType terms. PROPOSED additive contract (does not modify a frozen contract). Written in the catalog-subset the in-repo validator (timeline_core::schema) accepts, so the engine validates its own output; it is also valid JSON Schema draft-07. COMPATIBILITY: every change to this file must keep already-exported manifests valid. The `authored` origin, the `authored*` composition fields and the optional `assetHash` are all WIDENINGS for that reason - new values were added to enums and new keys added to `properties`, but nothing was added to any `required` list and no key was removed. A manifest written before `authored` existed still validates; a manifest written today does NOT validate against an older copy of this schema, which is the accepted direction.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest journal entry (the state the manifest reflects); empty for an empty journal.

hashChain.description: The blake3 hash-chain head. Recomputing the chain over journal.jsonl must reproduce tipHash at entryCount entries.

byClipCount.description: `authored` is NOT required: a manifest exported before the term existed has only the first three keys and must stay valid. The engine always writes all four.

byDuration.description: `authoredTicks` / `authoredPct` are NOT required, for the same backward-compatibility reason as `byClipCount.authored`.

aiDisclosure.description: EU AI Act Article 50(2) machine-readable disclosure. digitalSourceType is an IPTC DigitalSourceType IRI: trainedAlgorithmicMedia when all content is AI-generated, compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia when mixed, digitalCapture when no AI content is recorded.

assetHash.description: The clip's content-addressed asset hash. ABSENT when the clip has no underlying asset - a note clip is its notes, and the journal, not a file. It is deliberately not emitted as an empty string: "" is a claim that the hash IS the empty string, and an empty hash can only ever false-match a generative record. Not in `required` so every manifest exported before note clips existed (all of which carry it) stays valid.

origin.description: generated = a music model produced this audio (a gen.landed record carries its hash). imported = audio that arrived from outside the project. recorded = captured from an input: audio via record.stop, or a MIDI take played on a controller. authored = notes written in the piano roll - no asset, no capture, no model. `authored` was added after the first manifests shipped; adding an enum value is a widening, so those manifests stay valid.

digitalSourceType.description: IPTC DigitalSourceType IRI for THIS clip. digitalCreation ("media created by a human using non-generative tools") is the term for an authored note clip; digitalCapture would assert a capture device that was never involved.

lineage.description: Per-clip chain of custody. Generated clips carry sourceCommand + requestId + engine identity (and prompt/takeId when known); imported/recorded/authored clips carry sourceCommand and, for note clips, a note naming who wrote the notes. Loose (additionalProperties) so future lineage fields are forward-compatible.
